Faethoriel — a luminous cluster of soaring slender white spires linked by graceful arched stone bridges over a turquoise river-gorge, their glowing amber windows reflected in the rushing current below, pale towers catching diffused morning light against a veil of silver mist.

Sylvanthas — a treetop elven city of pale curved platforms and soaring spire-crowned canopies woven through colossal ancient trees, glowing lantern-windows suspended between arched bridges of living wood, the whole city breathing gently in the high canopy wind.

Caladrimor — a tiered cliffside city of white cascading terraces and needle-thin spires, graceful arched bridges spanning each luminous tier, warm glowing windows studding the pale stone, the whole grand cascade descending in serene elegance to a still and mirrored lake.

Vaelthurien — a city of soaring white towers rising beside a thundering waterfall, arched bridges vaulting the spray-filled gorge between them, glowing windows shimmering through the mist, the roar of falling water filling the grand open colonnades with perpetual silver sound.

Aelindra — a crystalline elven city of translucent white towers and soaring refracting spires above a mirror-lake, arched bridges catching prismatic light, soft rainbows drifting across glowing windows, the entire luminous city doubled in the calm and perfect water beneath.

Thornivael — a city grown into and around a single colossal living tree, white spires spiraling upward through ancient bark, graceful arched bridges curving between root-buttresses and canopy platforms, every glowing window warm as hearthlight inside the vast breathing green cathedral.

Eirandúl — a snow-dusted winter elven city of ice-white spires rising from a frozen vale, arched bridges glazed with frost connecting pale soaring towers, glowing amber windows burning against the grey winter sky, the whole city luminous and still beneath a hush of falling snow.

Mirelond — a lakeside elven city of white domes and soaring spires, graceful arched bridges curving over calm inlets, warm glowing windows throwing gold across the water at dusk, the grand white skyline reflected whole and trembling in the glassy lake surrounding it.

Aurenthal — a golden-autumn elven city of soaring white towers crowned by canopies of amber and copper foliage, arched bridges woven between flame-colored branches, glowing windows gilded by the season, pale spires rising serenely above a blazing ocean of autumn color.

Galaemist — a misty mountain-vale elven city of pale soaring spires half-dissolved in cloud, delicate arched bridges emerging from the white mist between towers, glowing windows burning soft as embers, the whole grand city existing at the luminous threshold between stone and sky.

Quethivara — a coastal elven harbor of curved white quays and soaring spires, arched bridges vaulting sea-channels between gleaming towers, glowing windows facing the open ocean, white sails drifting below as the city rises tier upon luminous tier above the blue and breathing sea.

Fenwethiel — a river-delta elven city where soaring white spires rise from braided silver waterways, long arched bridges connecting each gleaming island-tower, glowing windows warm against the evening water, the grand city spreading like a luminous crown across the floodplain's shifting light.

Daluvenor — an elven city carved into rose-veined white cliffs above a fjord, soaring spires erupting from the stone face, arched bridges leaping between carved terraces, glowing windows amber in the sheer pale rock, the whole breathtaking city gazing seaward from its grand stone throne.

Sithralorn — a forest-valley elven city of soaring white spires threaded between ancient silver birches, arched bridges drifting like white ribbons through the pale trunks, glowing windows scattered like fallen stars, the city luminous and quiet in its green-and-silver cathedral of living wood.

Eredhavan — a high mountain-pass elven city of slender white spires piercing the thin alpine air, arched bridges connecting soaring ridgeline towers above the clouds, glowing windows burning gold against grey stone and ice, the grand city commanding the entire valley in a sweep of pale grandeur.

Lúmiranthas — a dawn-facing elven city of eastward-tilted white spires and broad arched bridges catching the first light, glowing rose-gold windows blazing as the sun crests the horizon, the soaring towers luminous and grand in a flood of new morning glory.

Caervadiel — a white elven city rising from a chalk-white sea-cliff, soaring spires and arched bridges above crashing waves, glowing windows visible far out at sea like a constellation of warm light, the grand pale city a beacon for sailors across the open grey water.

Thelindwë — an island elven city of concentric soaring white spires rising from a circular lake, arched bridges radiating outward like the spokes of a pale wheel, glowing windows in every tier, the grand symmetrical city shimmering in perfect radial reflection on the still water below.

Varanduil — an underground-spring elven city rising from a vast cavern where soaring white spires reach toward an open sky-well above, arched bridges spanning the underground river below, glowing windows illuminating pale stone vaults, the whole luminous grand city hidden and cathedral-quiet within the earth.

Arandheloth — a white elven city at the confluence of two great rivers, soaring spires rising from the wedge of land between the currents, arched bridges spanning both waters, glowing windows reflected in the dark moving rivers, the grand city crowned in pale stone and starlight.

Mellithuris — a spring-blossom elven city of white soaring spires wreathed in cascading pale flowers, arched bridges garlanded with blooms connecting the tall towers, glowing windows soft behind curtains of white petals, the entire luminous city fragrant and grand beneath a canopy of endless blossom.

Sorvathiel — a white elven city perched above a volcanic caldera lake, soaring spires rising from the rim, arched bridges spanning the crater's edge, glowing windows illuminating pale stone against the deep blue of the sunken water below, the grand city both serene and magnificent.

Ithindral — a twilight elven city of soaring white spires veined in silver above a dark pine forest, arched bridges gleaming between towers in the failing light, glowing windows blazing violet-gold at dusk, the grand pale city luminous and solitary above the dark breathing forest below.

Galadremis — a white elven city built on terraced islands rising from a tidal estuary, soaring spires catching sea-wind above arched bridges reflected in tidal mirrors, glowing windows amber at low tide when the whole grand city stands revealed in its shimmering pale entirety.

Elenthavar — a star-watching elven city of soaring open-topped white spires and wide arched bridges beneath the open sky, glowing windows soft below as astronomers walk the high parapets, the grand luminous city arranged to frame the heavens, its pale towers rising like fingers reaching toward the stars.
